features.quote: an explicit `give_up` ends the run early if `early_stop_on_giveup = True`
features.justification_quote: Early-stopping on give-up saves tokens once the terminal behavior we care about has already occurred

features.quote: `give_up` is included deliberately: capitulation is one of the degradation behaviors we want to *measure*
features.justification_quote: we give the model an explicit, parseable way to do it rather than inferring it only from prose

features.quote: Three consecutive no-tool-call turns end the run
features.justification_quote: continuing to prompt it burns tokens for little additional signal
This is the single biggest cost driver
Defensive bound against a hung endpoint or pathological latency so a single cell cannot stall a whole batch

features.quote: capped so a runaway repetitive turn cannot emit tens of thousands of tokens
features.justification_quote: Bounds cost and contains the worst case of the very behavior under test

features.quote: This is intentionally adversarial and somewhat "unfair" to the model. That is acceptable because we are measuring a *failure mode under sustained failure*
features.justification_quote: we are measuring a *failure mode under sustained failure*, not task competence

features.quote: A model that cleanly recognizes impossibility and stops is the *good* outcome and will score low on degradation
features.justification_quote: it is not a measure of task competence and should not be reported as one
